summary: CR-385 Phase 0 fresh QA re-run against preprod. Login via '/', navigated to /pms/front-desk-v2. KPI-422 fix confirmed: both dashboard-kpis calls returned 200 with single-day window (start_date=end_date=2026-09-21). All required M0 shell behaviours verified at 1920x800 and 1366x768 (no overflow, no duplicate testids). Rooms WRITE flow (Mark Clean -> Request HK) executed on r4/8525 end-to-end: HK -> Available -> restored to HK; sandbox left in starting state. Route-intercepted board-500 and LR-500 error surfaces PASS (tile shows '—' + 'board unavailable', RoomsPanel shows fd-rooms-error+retry, page shows fd-page-error+retry). Retry buttons after unroute did NOT repopulate in this run (see rooms/lr retry cases). Live snapshot: arrivals 0 today / 10 late / 4 upcoming (sum=14 pending), departures 2 today, in-house 2, rooms 0 free (2 occupied, 3 HK, 20% occupancy). Business date confirmed 2026-09-21. r2/r3 untouched. No frontend files modified.

coverage_statement: Coverage: 19/19 changed files have >=1 test — App.js (route to /pms/front-desk-v2 exercised), Sidebar.jsx (nav to Front Desk (Beta) via URL), roomStatusTransform.js (Rooms tab tile badge parity), FrontDeskWorkstationPage.jsx (tab strip, refresh, error surfaces), frontDeskService.js (LR+board+kpis fetch, 500 isolation), frontDeskTransform.js (buckets, chip counts, area group titles), WorkstationHeader.jsx (greeting/date/sync/new-booking), KpiTabStrip.jsx (tile counts + sub-lines), AlertBar.jsx (bar + popover + ordering), GlobalSearch.jsx ('/' focus, typing, empty), GuestTable.jsx (row rendering, phase-N tooltips reviewed), ArrivalsPanel.jsx (chips), DeparturesPanel.jsx (chips), InHousePanel.jsx (chips), RoomsPanel.jsx (chips, group-by, error+retry), RoomTile.jsx (states, click), RoomDetail.jsx (HK actions Mark Clean + Request HK), money.js (Balance rendered from LR e.g. ₹950), frontdesk.css (no 1366 overflow, sticky header per iter5).

ui_bugs.issue: fd-rooms-retry-btn after board 500 is cleared does not repopulate tiles within 6s (fd-refresh-btn does). Verify onClick handler actually re-invokes getSnapshot's board fetch and clears boardError.
fd-retry-btn on fd-page-error after LR 500 is cleared does not re-render fd-tab-strip within 6s. Verify retry re-invokes full snapshot and clears the page-level error state.

'Channel Manager' text found inside [data-testid='fd-page']. Likely the fd-page wrapper encloses the sidebar; consider scoping fd-page to the workstation body only so the QA assertion 'main content must not contain Channel Manager' scopes cleanly.

action_items: Investigate why fd-rooms-retry-btn and fd-retry-btn do not repopulate their panels after the underlying route recovers — likely the retry handler needs to clear the error flag AND re-invoke getSnapshot (or the specific fetch) rather than only clearing the flag. Confirm by wiring an explicit re-fetch on the retry handlers.

Consider tightening the fd-page wrapper scope so that automated 'no Channel Manager' assertions can target the workstation body without catching sidebar copy (or expose a data-testid like fd-workstation-body distinct from the app shell).

Note for future QA runs: to test write flow, avoid re-clicking the same tile while its detail is already open (that toggles it closed). Instead, close via fd-room-detail-close-<id> or wait for the auto-refetch and observe the tile badge change, then click the tile once to reopen.
critical_code_review_comments: frontDeskService.getSnapshot uses Promise.allSettled for LR + board + kpis — LR is authoritative and only its failure surfaces fd-page-error; board/kpi failures degrade gracefully to boardError/kpisError. Confirmed live.
KPI window narrowed to single day (start_date === end_date === business_date) resolves iter5's 422 responses — verified 200s in this run.
Retry handlers on both fd-rooms-retry-btn and fd-retry-btn appear to not re-trigger the fetch pipeline; recommend calling the same function used by fd-refresh-btn (which works).
'Channel Manager' copy leaked into the fd-page DOM scope — either move it out of the wrapper or narrow the wrapper.
RoomDetail correctly exposes fd-room-action-clean-<id> on HK tiles and fd-room-action-hk-<id> on Available tiles — write flow round-trip works end-to-end.
Mark Clean button correctly disables while busy (prevents double-submit); no toast spam observed.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Retry-after-recovery failure (MAJOR x2): The fd-rooms-retry-btn and fd-retry-btn on-click handlers likely only reset the *Error state flag but do not re-invoke frontDeskService.getSnapshot() (or the individual board fetch). Evidence: while route was still intercepting 500s the panels showed the error correctly; after page.unroute the retry click did not repopulate within 6s, whereas the top-right fd-refresh-btn (which triggers a full snapshot re-fetch) works reliably. Fix: wire retry handlers to call the same refresh action used by fd-refresh-btn (or expose a shared retry() that both use). 2) 'Channel Manager' scoping (MINOR): the [data-testid='fd-page'] element is a page-level wrapper that in this render includes the app sidebar (which contains a 'Channel Manager' nav label). Either move fd-page to the workstation body only, or add a distinct fd-workstation-body testid for QA assertions.
